facts.name: Garlic High — Sunnyvale
facts.label: Garlic High
facts.tagline: A Jiro-style ramen shop on West Maude Avenue serving thick, curly noodles in pork bone broth under bean sprouts, cabbage, chashu and fresh garlic, plus brothless mazesoba.

sections.name: Ramen
items: Dine-in. 150g noodles and 1 slice of chashu pork: thick, curly noodles in a rich pork bone broth, topped with bean sprouts, garlic and cabbage.
Dine-in. 200g noodles and 2 slices of chashu pork, with bean sprouts, garlic and cabbage.
Dine-in. 300g noodles and 3 slices of chashu pork, with bean sprouts, garlic and cabbage.
150g noodles and 1 slice of chashu pork in pork bone broth. Bean sprouts, garlic and umami fat come in separate containers; boil fresh noodles 7 minutes.

sections.name: Mazesoba
items: Dine-in. 150g noodles and 1 slice of chashu pork, with fried onion, fresh egg, bean sprouts, garlic and cabbage.
Dine-in. 200g noodles and 2 slices of chashu pork, with fried onion, fresh egg, bean sprouts, garlic and cabbage.
Dine-in. 300g noodles and 3 slices of chashu pork, with fried onion, fresh egg, bean sprouts, garlic and cabbage.
200g noodles, 1 slice of chashu pork and a poached egg. Bean sprouts, garlic and umami fat come in separate containers; boil fresh noodles 7 minutes.
200g thick noodles in spicy sesame tantan sauce with sweet miso ground pork, egg yolk, cilantro and Kana chili mala oil. Contains peanut butter.

sections.name: T-Shirts
items: Black, yellow or white; S to XL.

facts.siteNote: Small, medium and large bowls are dine-in; pickup and delivery orders get the To Go ramen or mazesoba. You pick veg, garlic and umami fat levels: max veg is $3 more, heavy or max garlic or umami fat 50¢ or $1. Their Instagram says to text the number.
facts.hours: Tue–Sun 11:30am–1:30pm & 5:30–8:30pm; Fri–Sat to 9pm; Sat–Sun lunch to 2pm; closed Mon

glenn: 27 Oct 6:28 pm: Instagram screenshots of @garlic.high_sunnyvale, 'https://www.garlic-high.com/', 'Sunnyvale • Eats / BEASTY • Ramen / New Category'.
flags: Hours are their Square business hours, which match Google (via Restaurant Guru) and Instagram's 'OPEN TUE–SUN'. The online-order windows on garlic-high.com are wider (Tue–Thu 11am–2pm & 5–10pm, Fri–Sat to 11pm, Sun 9am–3pm & 5–10pm), so not used.
Frankiapp lists phone (408) 599-9475 and garbled hours ('11:30am–1:30am'); their site and Instagram say (669) 899-7165.
Atmosfy lists 511 Borregas Ave, Sunnyvale; their site, Instagram and Google say 107 W Maude Ave.
Instagram says to text (669) 899-7165; whether they take calls is unverified.
Left out as sold out and not in any menu category (last edited May 2026): Pork Curry Rice $10, Unagi Bowl $18, Onigiri $4, SALE Eel $10, Karaage $5. Also sold out now: Diet Coke $2.50, Mini Rice $2.
Their Square account also holds a disabled second store, 'Japanese bento catering company', at the same address with email fujiben.order@gmail.com; not used.
Item names are title-cased from their all-caps listing. Tantan Chashu Bowl and Savage Chashu Bowl have no description on their site.

Menu read from their Square Online store's public data (the Chrome extension was not connected), not from a rendered page. Yelp blocked fetching (403); Google was checked only through Restaurant Guru.
